human_understanding_delta: The Vieta-small root selection was unnecessary. For every m>r>=1 and every quotient root w of w^m+a*w^r+c, the exact identity P(u*w)=(1-u^r)c-(u^r-u^m)w^m spends two nonnegative coefficients whose sum is 1-u^m. When |w|<1 and |c|<1, the whole spoke is therefore strictly safe. This proves Erdős #1041 for every centred trinomial z^m+a*z^r+c and, via the regular-fibre mean-square identity, every translated cyclic lift (z-h)^(qm)+a(z-h)^(qr)+c with q>=2, at all allowed coefficient scales.
